summary:
FB-4 setup verified. 3-arm fast-split benchmark configured and ready for manual execution.

ON arm: 5 repos × selflearn AGENTS.md present (pandas 17L, astropy 21L, sphinx 21L, seaborn 6L, sympy 8L). KB injection via FB_KB_PATH static fallback path (AGENTS.md → /testbed/AGENTS.md in container). 61 notes exported.

Sonnet arm: 5 repos × sonnet AGENTS.md present (pandas 18L, astropy 23L, sphinx 21L, seaborn 19L, sympy 18L).

OFF arm: config-fb-off.toml wired, no KB injection.

Auth: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY NOT SET. Claude CLI works via OAuth session (host only). Docker containers need explicit ANTHROPIC_API_KEY — OAuth from `claude login` (~/.claude/.credentials.json) is NOT forwarded to containers. User must set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY before running.

Docker: running. Pandas image already pulled (libercoders/featurebench-specs_pandas-instance_15f634a6). Other 4 repo images not yet pulled.

Smoke (1 instance ON arm): SKIP — auth blocked (no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).

Scripts:
- scripts/run-fb-smoke.ps1: 1-instance smoke on pandas test_col, ON arm (~30 min)
- scripts/run-fb-full.ps1: full 3-arm 15-instance run (~7.5h)
Both scripts validate ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set before running and substitute it + per-repo FB_KB_PATH into a temp config at runtime.

To run: $env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "sk-ant-..."; cd D:\zonoid; .\scripts\run-fb-smoke.ps1

subject: FB-4: Run fast split across 3 arms + stats (pilot result)
description: Execute the pilot benchmark and report. Steps: (1) run the 100-instance fast split across OFF / ON-plain / ON-self-learning with identical scaffold+model (Sonnet 4.6); (2) collect resolved (0/1), input/output tokens, tool_calls per task; (3) report pass@1 + L1 vs L2 breakdown per arm; (4) two-proportion z-test (ON vs OFF) on resolved rate, Mann-Whitney U on token counts. Success: a pilot result table with significance, showing whether KB injection (and the judge step) earns its cost. Depends on FB-3.
